hero.name: Chema
hero.tagline: From React interfaces to FastAPI inference services on Azure — I work across the full stack to ship systems where AI does something real, not decorative. Currently at NTT DATA's innovation team in Barcelona.

about.title: About Me
about.bio1: I'm a fullstack engineer at NTT DATA's innovation team in Barcelona. I build AI-powered systems end-to-end — from React interfaces to FastAPI backends deployed on Azure, with real-time data layers in between.
about.bio2: My focus is the point where AI models stop being a demo and start being a product. Currently exploring Physical AI: systems where model output drives something in the real world, not just a UI.
about.motto: Keep learning, keep building — curiosity makes great engineers.

bullets: Develop AI-powered features end-to-end in a small innovation team — FastAPI inference services, React interfaces, and Azure deployments from whiteboard to production.
Built a real-time state synchronization system using WebSockets on FastAPI — broadcasting session state across concurrent clients with sub-100ms delivery.
Advanced to hackathon semifinals with an AI research assistant built end-to-end in 48h: document ingestion, retrieval pipeline, and LLM-generated synthesis.
Deepening work in Physical AI — connecting model outputs to real-world hardware and autonomous systems.
Diagnosed and repaired hardware and software issues.
Assembled and configured PCs from the ground up.
Provided in-person technical support to customers.
